about: What each module file of scripts/ may hold, held by tools/comments-lint.mjs (node tools/check.mjs comments): `citations` (a backticked name in a comment that no code, language key or stylesheet of the repository holds: renamed, removed, or somebody else's) and `doubledJsdoc` (two JSDoc blocks with nothing between them; a file's header before its first declaration's block not counted). A count above its row fails: a comment added one. A count below fails until the row is lowered in the same commit, so the budget only falls. `known` holds names read and kept, each with its reason (a Foundry, Daggerheart or browser name; a history line), which are counted nowhere. Written at a31e7a3b's counts on 13.11.2026 (E56 C1 on main's base; prep-54 first wrote it at 4dfac3a9: 175 names, 63 doubled blocks); E56 lowers it to zero or to `known` names. The rows are written by `node tools/comments-lint.mjs --write`, which lowers a row to its count and never raises one, from a run, never by hand. On 14.11.2026 E56 part 2 took every row to zero (141 citations in 77 files and 3 doubled blocks on 9e7e3d78): a doubled block is an error since then whatever a row says (R7150), and a citation is held at zero by R7151, so a name a comment needs to keep bare goes into `known` with its reason.
